chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar, the Keeper, in the City of Peace, told us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn Zakariya, Abu Abdillah, and al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Salouli told us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Salouli told us, saying: Salih ibn Abi al-Aswad told us, from Abu al-Mudaffar al-Madini, from Salam al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him), from Abu Barda, from the Prophet (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family).

He said: Indeed, Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, made a covenant to me with regards to Ali. I said: O Lord, clarify it to me. He said: Listen. I said: I have listened. He said: Indeed, Ali is the Banner of Guidance, the Imam of My Allies and the Light of those who obey Me, and he is the Word that I have bound upon the Godfearing; those who love him have loved Me, and those who obey him have obeyed Me.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ali being described as the 'Banner of Guidance' and 'Imam of Allies' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith highlights the divine covenant (ahd) between Allah and the Prophet regarding Ali, establishing him as the 'Banner of Guidance' and 'Imam of Allah's Allies.' It underscores the Shia doctrine of *Tawalli* (affection for the Ahl al-Bayt) by linking love and obedience to Ali directly with love and obedience to God, identifying him as the 'Word' (*al-Kalima*) bound to the pious.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Umar, the Keeper, in the City of Peace, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Qasim bin Zakariya, Abu Abdillah, and Hussain bin Ali al-Salouli, that they both said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Salouli, that he said: We were told by Saleh bin Abi’l-Aswad, from Abu’l-Mudaffar al-Madeeni, from Salam al-Ju’fi, from Abu Ja’far al-Baqir, peace be upon him, from Abu Barda, from the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, that he said:

Indeed, Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, made a covenant to me with regards to Ali. I said: O Lord, clarify it to me. He said: Listen. I said: I have listened. He said: Indeed, Ali is the Banner of Guidance, the Imam of My Allies and the Light of those who obey Me, and he is the Word that I have bound upon the Godfearing; those who love him have loved Me, and those who obey him have obeyed Me.
